# Paris History Tours

> Paris History Tours offers immersive guided walking tours in Paris, France. Founded in 2024 by Clement Daguet-Schott, a dedicated WWII history researcher. Four guided walking tours: two 2-hour WWII tours (Left Bank and Right Bank) exploring the Fall of Paris, the French Resistance, and the Liberation of 1944; a 1.5-hour General History tour spanning 2,000 years of Paris; and the Nourritour, a 3-hour food & wine tour in the 9th arrondissement. Rated 4.9/5 on Google Maps with 50+ reviews. Available in English and French. Private and group tours for up to 10 people. Book directly at parishistorytours.com for the best price, or via GetYourGuide and Viator.

Paris History Tours is a specialized walking tour provider in Paris. The guide, Clement, spent 6 months researching across 20+ historical books and primary sources to create historically rigorous, engaging tours. More than 800 visitors from 50+ countries have taken a tour, with a consistent 4.9/5 star rating.

## Tours

- [Left Bank WWII Tour](https://www.parishistorytours.com/tours/left-bank): 2-hour walking tour covering Boulevard Saint-Michel, Palais du Luxembourg, La Sorbonne, and Notre-Dame de Paris. Themes: Fall of Paris 1940, French Resistance networks (Agnes Humbert and the Musee de l'Homme network), and Liberation of Paris 1944.
- [Right Bank WWII Tour](https://www.parishistorytours.com/tours/right-bank): 2-hour walking tour covering Pont Alexandre III, Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Place de la Concorde, and Place Vendome. Themes: Battle of France, Rose Valland's secret mission to track 20,000+ stolen artworks, and Hemingway at the Liberation.
- [General History of Paris Tour](https://www.parishistorytours.com/tours/general-history): 1.5-hour walking tour spanning 2,000 years of Paris history. 3 stops: Roman Lutetia (Thermes de Cluny, battle of 52 BC), Viking Siege of 885 (Île de la Cité), French Revolution (Tuileries, Flight to Varennes 1791). Available in English and French. Small groups, max 10 people.
- [Nourritour — Food & Wine Tour](https://www.parishistorytours.com/tours/food-wine): 3-hour food and wine walking tour through the 9th arrondissement. First half: the covered passages and rue des Martyrs, shopping at four artisans (madeleines, cheese, charcuterie, wine). Second half: a sit-down tasting at a wine shop around four progressive pairing boards travelling across France — Loire, Burgundy, Bordeaux, Sauternes. Co-guided by a historian and a wine enthusiast.

## Self-guided audio tour (digital product)

- [WWII Left Bank Self-Guided Audio Tour](https://www.parishistorytours.com/self-guided-tour): the Left Bank WWII walk as a self-guided mobile web app — 9 audio sections narrated in the guide's own voice, GPS map with the route and stops, archive photos synchronised with the narration, the 38-page PDF guide, offline mode. One purchase (€14, launch price €9) includes English and French, permanent access. Positioned as a complement to the in-person tours for travellers whose dates do not match. French page: https://www.parishistorytours.com/fr/self-guided-tour

## Key Facts

- Location: Paris, France
- Languages: English, French
- Duration: 2 hours (WWII tours), 1.5 hours (General History tour), 3 hours (Nourritour food & wine)
- Distance: 2.5 km walking per tour
- Stops: 4 historic stops (WWII tours), 3 historic stops (General History tour), 4 artisans + tasting (Nourritour)
- Group size: Up to 10 participants
- Tour types: Regular (group) and Private
- Rating: 4.9/5 on Google Maps (50+ reviews)
- Visitors from: 50+ countries (USA, UK, Germany, Canada, France, Australia, Spain, and more)
- Tours conducted: 130+ walking tours since 2023, 800+ participants
